task_instance: Given a pasted WordPress Site Health Status report (1 critical HTTPS issue, 5 recommended improvements across Security/Performance/SEO, 12 passed tests), produce the skill's core deliverable: a risk-tiered fix plan with a triage table, Tier 1/2/3 sections, exact WP-CLI/PHP snippets, backup/lint/rollback steps, and a Safety section.
evidence: Read SKILL.md; the skill is explicitly advisory ('Cannot execute anything itself against a live site - every WP-CLI/PHP snippet is drafted for the user'), so its deliverable is a text plan, not a live-site change. Created sample input site-health-report.txt (a realistic Status-tab paste). Produced fix-plan.md following Phase 1-5: a triage table (item|category|tier|fix), Tier 1 recipes (remove inactive plugins, keep fallback theme, disable WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY, fix indexing toggle), Tier 2 recipes (HTTPS with dry-run search-replace, persistent object cache with host precondition), Tier 3 informational (green MySQL/PHP items left alone), a next-step re-run note, and the full 6-point Safety section with backup/lint/rollback. Verified by re-reading my own output: each non-passed report item maps to the correct tier and recipe from Phase 2-3, passed/green items are correctly classified Tier 3 with no action, no fabricated 'wp site-health' command was used (Phase 4), and no URL/domain was emitted into placeholders (used OLD-SITE token). No code execution, binary output, network, or connector tool was needed; all work done with text read/write only. Files: site-health-report.txt, fix-plan.md, result.json in the work directory.
